NARRATIVE AND PLANS.
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment -
746-48 North Trumbull Avenue
From B3-1 to RM-5

The Property ,
The subject property is situated in a B3-1 zoning district south of Chicago Avenue. The property is adjacent to an RS-
3 zoning district to the south. The area overall is comprised of various R-zoned districts including RS-3, RT-4, RM-
4.5, and RM-5. The subject site also is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 260.0’ the CTA Chicago
Avenue Bus (Route 66).

The property is improved with a two story residential building (approx. 24.0’ height) with two dwelling units and no
parking.

The Project
Adriana Espinoza and Alejandro Espinoza (the “Applicants”) seek to rezone the property to add a third dwelling unit

to the basement for a total of three dwelling units on the property. No building additions are proposed. The building
height will remain the same. No parking will be added.

The Applicants seek to rezone the property from a B3-1, Community Shopping District to an RM-5, Residential
Multi-Unit District.

As part of the rezoning application, the Applicants also seek all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, through a Type-1 application under Section 17-13-0300(D) including but not limited to: 1) an optional variation
under Section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front yard setback per Section 17-2-0305 to zero; 2) an optional variation
under Section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the north side yard setback per Section 17-2-0309 to zero; 3) _an optional
variation under Section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the south side yard setback per Section 17-2-0309 to 4.0’ to allow
placement of bicycle parking on along the south side of the property; 4) an optional variation under Section 17-13-
1101-B to reduce the combined side yard setbacks per Section 17-2-0309 to 4.0’; 5) an optional variation under
Section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback per Section 17-2-0306 to zero (existing), and 6) an optional
variation under Section 17-13-1003-K to reduce rear yard open space per Section 17-2-0307 to zero (existing).

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,096 square feet
FAR: 1.2
Floor Area: 2,445.58 square feet
Residential Dwelling Units: 3
MLA Density: 698.7 square feet
Height: 24.0"
Automobile Parking: zero (existing)
Bicycle Parking: 3
Rear Yard Open Space: zero (existing)
Setbacks Front (east/Trumbull): —_zero*

Side (north): zero*

Side (south): 4.0°*

Rear (west): zero*

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
